tasks.title: Supabase local project (backend/) and web client wiring
tasks.description: Create the Supabase local project (Docker) under backend/ and add the Supabase client + env handling in web/.
tasks.details: supabase init in backend/, config.toml, migrations folder, seed.sql. Add @supabase/supabase-js + @supabase/ssr in web/, server and browser clients, .env.example with the required keys (never commit .env). Document local start/stop commands in README. Needed by auth and Kudos. The `supabase` MCP server in .mcp.json (http://localhost:54321/mcp) only connects once `supabase start` is running.
tasks.testStrategy: supabase start succeeds locally; a unit test for the client factory; typecheck passes.
